question: 今年按收入项目汇总的待划拨金额，排名前五的收入项目是哪些？
sql: SELECT funddivide_transfer.fitemname AS fitemname, sum(funddivide_transfer.ftransamt) AS "划拨金额", sum(CASE WHEN funddivide_transfer.fistransfer = '1' THEN funddivide_transfer.ftransamt END) AS "划拨完成金额" FROM yunnan0508.fne_funddivide_transfer AS funddivide_transfer WHERE toDate(funddivide_transfer.fcleardate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(funddivide_transfer.fcleardate) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY funddivide_transfer.fitemname ORDER BY "划拨金额" DESC SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
